dialogues.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
dialogues.text: Not decisive, nor sharp, nor quick, nor experienced... There's still room for improvement.

response.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
response.text: Hmm... Yes, this seems worth the effort. Let us begin, then!

response.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
response.text: My benefactor? Sorry, I don't know much about him either.

response.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
response.text: I only know that he has a keen eye for Onikabuto.

response.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
response.text: When no one else was interested in my Onikabuto Magic Show Troupe, he was the only one who kept coming to my shows. He even memorized the name of every single Onikabuto.

response.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
response.text: Though the Mora he gave me was only enough for me to buy two bowls of Unagi Chazuke, he is my biggest and only supporter. I'd help him for free!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... So you used to actually train Onikabuto to put on shows? No wonder you used so many fancy words just now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we'll go watch your Onikabuto show once we finish the beetle brawl!

response.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
response.text: Haha... I've been barely able to make ends meet for years, so I'm looking for another way out.

response.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
response.text: If we are fated, you may hear the name "Wizard Moneybags" again years from now.

response.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
response.text: Well, see you later. I need to really think about how I can improve...
